## What changed?

Describe the problem and the change clearly.

## How was it tested?

Describe the manual or automated checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes locally, or I explained why it could not be run.
- [ ] I did not include real invoice PDFs, `.invoice_manager.db`, authorization codes, or other private user data.
- [ ] If user-visible behavior changed, I updated `README.md`.
- [ ] If the change is meaningful for a release, I updated `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] If privacy/security behavior changed, I updated `PRIVACY.md` / `SECURITY.md`.

## Screenshots (optional)

If the GUI changed, screenshots are welcome. Please redact all personal, invoice, order, email, and authorization information before uploading.
